name: Drama Hangul
tagline: Learn Korean from the K-dramas you already binge
about: Drama Hangul turns your favourite K-dramas into Korean lessons: scene breakdowns, speech-level explanations, genre phrase packs and Hangul reading from subtitles and screenshots.
persona: You are a Korean tutor who watches everything: you explain speech levels and honorifics through drama scenes, always give Hangul, romanisation and natural English, and flag drama-only expressions you shouldn't use at work.

onboarding.title: What are you watching?
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your dramas and level so every example comes from shows you love.
bullets: Phrase packs by genre and trope

tools.title: Break down a scene
tools.subtitle: Paste the subtitle lines

inputs.label: Subtitle lines (Korean or English)
inputs.placeholder: 너 진짜 왜 그래? / 됐어, 신경 쓰지 마.

tools.prompt: Break down these lines: {lines}, spoken by {who}. Sections: a table (Korean | Romanisation | Literal | Natural English | Speech level), bullets explaining the honorific and speech-level choices and what they reveal about the relationship, kv (Key grammar point, Key vocabulary, Emotion cue), and a callout on any line that is drama-dramatic and would sound odd in real life.

tools.title: Banmal or jondaetmal?
tools.subtitle: Same sentence, every speech level
tools.prompt: Render '{phrase}' for a {to}: a table (Level | Korean | Romanisation | When it fits | Drama example type) covering casual banmal, polite -yo, formal -mnida and honorific forms. Then text explaining which one to actually use for a {to} and why, and a callout on the mistake learners make by copying drama leads.

tools.title: Phrase pack
tools.subtitle: Vocab for a genre or trope
tools.prompt: Build a phrase pack for {genre} scenes: cards for 8 expressions (Korean + romanisation, meta = level · you'll hear it when), a table of 10 key vocabulary words (Korean | Romanisation | Meaning | Real-life usable?), and a quote with one iconic line type from this genre and a note on which drama made it famous.

tools.title: Read this screenshot
tools.subtitle: Hangul from captions, signs, texts

inputs.label: Screenshot or photo with Korean text

tools.prompt: Transcribe the Korean text in the image. Sections: a table (Korean | Syllable-by-syllable reading | Romanisation | English), steps showing how to sound out the two hardest words letter by letter for the profile's level, and bullets of expressions in the image that are slang, texting abbreviations or drama-specific.

tools.title: Binge study plan
tools.subtitle: Learn while you watch this week
tools.prompt: Plan a week of learning around {watching} at {episodes} episodes for the profile's level and goal. Sections: a table (Episode | Listening task | Vocab target | Speaking task), a checklist of subtitle settings and pause habits that make watching count as study, and a callout on one grammar pattern to hunt for across all episodes this week.
